sops.name: Missed Call Recovery
steps: Create or match customer record by caller ID.
Send transactional callback SMS if consent policy permits.
Place AI callback if configured and within allowed hours.
Ask reason for call and detect safety intent first.
Qualify and book if possible.
If no response, create follow-up task and send second attempt after configured delay.
Report recovered call value using configured average ticket assumptions.
sops.failure_handling: Notify CSR queue after max attempts.

sops.name: After-Hours Service
steps: Detect critical safety issue.
Apply after-hours service policy.
Disclose after-hours fee only if configured.
Classify urgency.
Book on-call appointment or transfer to on-call manager.
Send confirmation with arrival expectations.
Create high-priority dispatch note.
sops.failure_handling: Escalate to on-call manager if booking API unavailable.

sops.name: Estimate Follow-Up
steps: Wait configured follow-up interval.
Send personalized follow-up referencing service context.
Ask whether customer has questions, timing concerns, price concerns, or needs financing.
Route objection to objection playbook.
Offer call with comfort advisor for replacement estimates.
Update estimate status and next follow-up date.
Stop after opt-out, rejection, or max attempts.
sops.failure_handling: Move to nurture campaign after max attempts.

sops.name: Post-Repair Membership Offer
steps: Wait until job completion and customer satisfaction confirmed.
Explain membership benefit tied to the completed repair.
Present configured plan options.
Offer enrollment link or human callback.
If declined, capture reason and schedule seasonal reminder if allowed.
sops.failure_handling: Suppress offer if complaint or unresolved issue exists.

sops.name: Review Request
steps: Confirm customer is satisfied if sentiment unknown.
Send review link according to tenant review policy.
If positive reply, request public review.
If negative reply, route to service recovery instead of public review ask.
Update review_request_status.
sops.failure_handling: Do not repeatedly request after no response beyond configured limit.

sops.name: Warranty Question Handling
steps: Match customer and equipment record.
Collect install date, model, serial, and problem summary when missing.
Explain that warranty status must be verified.
Avoid confirming coverage unless CRM has verified warranty field.
Book diagnostic or create manager review task.
Record warranty_claim_context.
sops.failure_handling: Escalate to service manager if customer disputes coverage.

sops.name: Commercial Authorization Capture
steps: Capture company, site, contact, billing contact, and service address.
Ask for PO, NTE amount, landlord authorization, or property manager approval requirements.
Store access instructions.
Flag product loss, tenant impact, or business closure risk.
Book commercial technician or escalate to coordinator.
Send confirmation to site and billing contacts if permitted.
sops.failure_handling: Queue coordinator review if authorization is incomplete.
